subject: maths
question: Find the duration (in years) in which ₹1,200 will amount to ₹2,280 at a rate of 4% per annum simple interest.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest = Amount − Principal = 2280 − 1200 = 1080

Interest per year = 4% of 1200 = 48

Time = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year = 1080 ÷ 48 = 22.5 years

**∴ The correct answer is 22.5 years.**
